'''[[Canada]]''' competed at the '''[[2012 Winter Youth Olympics]]''' in [[Innsbruck]].  [[Beckie Scott]] was named as the chef de mission.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.cbc.ca/sports/2.722/beckie-scott-named-chef-de-mission-for-2012-youth-olympics-1.1099424 | title=Beckie Scott named chef de mission for 2012 Youth Olympics | access-date=March 24, 2011 | date=March 24, 2011 | publisher=CBC}}</ref>

Canada did not send any [[speed skating|speed skaters]] ([[long track speed skating|long]] and [[short track speed skating|short]] track), along with [[figure skating|figure skaters]] after the governing body for the sport in the country ([[Speed Skating Canada]] and [[Skate Canada]], respectively) deemed the event "not developmentally appropriate".<ref>[http://speedskating.ca/client/cmsUploads/speed_skating/File/AGM2011/Presentations/SSC%20AGM_2011%20Youth%20Olympic_Games_ver3.pdf Speed skating Canada 2012 Winter Youth Olympics]{{Dead link|date=November 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
{{TOC limit|3}}

==Alpine skiing==
{{Main|Alpine skiing at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics}}
Canada had qualified a full team of two boys and two girls. The team was announced on June 22, 2011.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://canski.org/four-skiers-to-represent-canada-at-winter-youth-olympic-games | title=Four skiers to represent Canada at Winter Youth Olympic Games | work=Alpine Canada | date=June 22, 2011 | accessdate=June 23, 2011 }}{{Dead link|date=November 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

==Biathlon==
{{Main|Biathlon at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics}}
Canada had qualified a full biathlon team of 2 boys and 2 girls. ==Curling==
{{Main|Curling at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics}}
Canada had qualified a mixed curling team of 2 boys and 2 girls. Canada's roster was announced on April 8, 2011.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://whitehorsestar.com/archive/story/yukon-curler-picked-to-represent-canada-at-2012-world-youth-olympics/|title=Yukon curler picked to represent Canada at 2012 World Youth Olympics|publisher=[[Whitehorse Star]]|date=2011-04-08|accessdate=2011-04-09}}</ref>

'''Skip:''' [[Thomas Scoffin]]<br/>
'''Third:''' [[Corryn Brown]]<br/>
'''Second:''' [[Derek Oryniak]]<br/>
'''Lead:''' [[Emily Best (curler)|Emily Gray]]

The mixed team event took place 14–18 January, while the mixed doubles tournament took place 20–22 January.

== Figure skating==
{{Main|Figure skating at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics}}
Canada had qualified an ice dancing team, a pair, and 2 boys' singles skaters. However, on January 4, 2012, it was announced that, due to a scheduling conflict with the Canadian nationals (held in [[Moncton, NB]]), Canada would not send figure skaters after all.<ref>[http://news.ca.msn.com/sports/article.aspx?cp-documentid=31904710 Canadian skaters not going to Youth Olympics]{{Dead link|date=November 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

{{Main|Freestyle skiing at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics}}
Canada had qualified a full freestyle skiing team of 4 athletes.<ref>[http://www.innsbruck2012.com/en/sports/athletes Canada freestyle skiing athletes]</ref>

==Ice hockey==
{{Main|Ice hockey at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics}}
Canada would enter a boys team and it consisted of 17 athletes.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://corporate.olympics.com.au/files/41/QualificationSystem_2012YOG_IceHockey_April2010.pdf |title=QUALIFICATION SYSTEM - 1STWINTER YOUTH OLYMPIC GAMES IN 2012 INTERNATIONAL ICE HOCKEY FEDERATION |access-date=2011-03-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120826002332/http://corporate.olympics.com.au/files/41/QualificationSystem_2012YOG_IceHockey_April2010.pdf |archive-date=2012-08-26 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

The co-coaches were announced October 14, 2011, and would be Jim Hulton and Curtis Hunt.<ref>[http://www.hockeycanada.ca/index.php/ci_id/176224/la_id/1/ss_id/7158/ JIM HULTON AND CURTIS HUNT NAMED CO-COACHES FOR MEN’S TEAM AT 2012 WINTER YOUTH OLYMPIC GAMES]</ref>

The players were announced October 21, 2011, and were selected through a process that involved a random draw from a list of 39 names established by Hockey Canada's thirteen branches, with each branch guaranteed at least one representative (Ontario, Québec and Alberta were guaranteed one extra representative each).<ref>[http://www.hockeycanada.ca/index.php/ci_id/176587/la_id/1/ss_id/7158/ HOCKEY CANADA ANNOUNCES MEN'S HOCKEY PLAYERS NOMINATED FOR 2012 WINTER YOUTH OLYMPIC GAMES]</ref> The players selected are as follows.<ref>[http://www.hockeycanada.ca/index.php/ci_id/176208/la_id/1.htm CANADA ROSTER - 2012 YOUTH OLYMPIC GAMES]</ref>

Goaltenders:
* Keven Bouchard (QC)
* Sam Walsh (PEI)

Defence:
* Josh Carrick (ON)
* Jarrett Crossman (NB)
* Joe Hicketts (BC)
* Brycen Martin (AB)
* Brendan Nickerson (NS)
* Ryan Pilon (SK)

Forwards:
* Adam Brooks (MB)
* Ryan Burton (ON)
* Eric Cornel (ON)
* Reid Duke (AB)
* Reid Gardiner (SK)
* Ryan Gropp (BC)
* Nicolas Hébert (QC)
* Garrett James (ON)
* Nathan Yetman (NL)
